system.name: SuperOffload
system.one_liner: a Superchip-centric offloading system that jointly optimizes data placement, computation, and tensor migration between Hopper GPU and Grace CPU for LLM training

components.name: SA-DFG
components.role: Superchip-aware dataflow graph example showing per-op GPU/CPU cost and tensor sizes (Step, Cast, FWD, BWD nodes)

components.name: Grace CPU
components.role: CPU side of the Superchip hosting optimizer state and offloaded computation

components.name: Hopper GPU
components.role: GPU side of the Superchip performing forward/backward compute

components.name: NVLINK-C2C (900GB/s)
components.role: high-bandwidth interconnect between Grace CPU and Hopper GPU that SuperOffload fully utilizes

components.name: Speculation-then-Validation (§4.4)
components.role: runs a speculative optimizer step, validates it, and rolls back on failure

components.name: GraceAdam (§4.6)
components.role: optimized Adam optimizer implementation for Grace CPU

components.name: Weight-Stationary or Flow Offloading (§4.2)
components.role: adaptive policy choosing whether weights stay resident or flow between GPU and CPU

components.name: Bucketization Repartitioning (§4.3)
components.role: adjusts bucketization and fine-grained repartitioning of optimizer state to balance workload

components.name: Superchip-Aware Casting (§4.5)
components.role: casts/moves tensors in a way aware of Superchip compute/communication costs

content.key_idea: SuperOffload treats the tightly-coupled Hopper GPU + Grace CPU Superchip as a single Superchip-aware dataflow graph and applies a bundle of techniques (adaptive offloading, bucketization repartitioning, Superchip-aware casting, speculative optimizer execution, GraceAdam) to fully exploit the 900GB/s NVLink-C2C link.
content.reading_order: Top: SA-DFG mini example showing per-op cost annotations; then left-to-right across the two Superchip halves (Grace CPU techniques on the left, Hopper GPU techniques on the right) joined by the NVLink-C2C column in the middle.

it adjusts the bucketization strategy and leverages fine-grained repartitioning to balance the workload

summary: This figure gives the system overview of SuperOffload, an offloading system for training LLMs on NVIDIA GH200-style Superchips that pair a Hopper GPU with a Grace CPU over a 900GB/s NVLink-C2C link. At the top, a small Superchip-aware dataflow graph (SA-DFG) example shows how each tensor operator's cost differs depending on whether it runs on GPU or CPU (Step, Cast, FWD, BWD nodes with data-size and cost labels). The main body is split into a Grace CPU column and a Hopper GPU column joined by the NVLink-C2C bar, annotating SuperOffload's five techniques: weight-stationary/flow offloading, bucketization repartitioning, Superchip-aware casting, speculation-then-validation optimizer stepping, and the GraceAdam optimizer. The figure is a dense, boxed architecture diagram with green section headers, red cost-highlighting accents, and small icons for validation/rollback.
summary_zh: 该图展示SuperOffload系统概览：顶部SA-DFG示例标注各算子在GPU/CPU上的开销；主体按Grace CPU与Hopper GPU两栏布局，中间为NVLink-C2C互联，标注自适应卸载、分桶再分区、芯片感知类型转换、推测验证优化器步骤与GraceAdam等技术。
